content: Livanen peiyaw

Ikous, mo itamanaw Yeisuw, inoun in wawnuwan Yudiy mo iga̱pel lay Yoldan, in palatan. Vayuwein-vak gamag babaw mo ikatuyouns ininekes Yeisuw, mo ivgavaw katimlakay gamag wasigeis, peinan nawotet tut babaw ma̱wan.
Tasiyas gog Palisiy mo inekes Yeisuw, sivines kid biyakwanes, mo ikatiga̱nes Yeisuw, ilansa, “Tab kadilok bitapiyev dakwav, ne?”
Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Kweiboug Moses bo isekeimiy mikaleiwag, ama̱wan?”
Ilansa, “Moses bo itam, nakaleiwag ma̱wan towen, kukin vin bitapiyev, inalet bitalel tasek mo tapiyev.”
Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Peinan ninoumiy keikay yakamiy, mo isekeimiy nakaleiwag towen.

“Tage kweiboug Yowbad niginbun gamag kuda̱taw son kuda̱vin, mapuna taw bilisow taman son inan, binek nakwav, mapuna asteiy bimlavag wous katanok. Nag teitan na̱tan, nag; wous bo ilatanes imlavag katanok-wan.
“Peinan Yowbad bo ilaten, awoum gamag bilivis, awoum.”
Ikous, iyums ineis wanbunatum, navamul mo ikatiga̱nes vayuwein, sivines kid bikakins silawun nakatimlakay towen.
Yeisuw mo idibakes, ilana, “Kukin kal bipiyev nakwav, bivevaw gog nayuwein vin, mo biyageg nakwav tatonen, peinan taggeinawl towen ikanavay mav.
“Na̱wen-vak kukin bipiyev namwan, o beivay gog son tayuwein taw mo bikanavay mav.”
Yeisuw sivinan gamagal
Wankuyeim gamag mo imeyes nitsiyas, sivines Yeisuw naman bisen wawous. Tage navamul idokes kid bisilbwades gamagals, awoum kid bimekes Yeisuw.
Yeisuw gog ikines, mo ika̱nes, ilana, “Gamagal bweina bimeis waseg yey. Awoum kusilbwades, peinan tasiyas wanuwan Yowbad nakaleiwag mamagina gamagal.
“Mounid adibakeimiy, kukin beivag ninoumiy ma̱wana gamagal mo bukutams Yowbad nakaleiwag waseg, mo bukusiws wanuwan. Kukin gog nag, bo nag.”
Ilivan ikous, iwliboub gamagal wasigeis, naman isen wawous, anilivan bwanabwein mo isekes gamagal tasiyas.
Guyaw teitan ipiyev Yeisuw
Ikous, ininoun wa̱ked, mo teitan taw isawl inek, ikulul avakaein wamatan, ilana, “Takatimlakay bwanabwein yak, aveiyag bavag mo mwamovag nag beikous?”

Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Aveiyag wawun kudokeig toubwein yey? Toubwein anmwa̱net Yowbad. Adok kaleiwag tasiyas kukwakin: awoum kuweiy gamag, awoum kwanavay mav, awoum kuveinaw, awoum kuyaweid, awoum kusilponay, o kuvna̱ses tamam son inam.”
Iwa̱ge, ilana, “Tamwey, igaw-o wagwa̱dig asilamaw kaleiwag tasiyas oko nagein igawa avvalut kaleiwag tasiyas wasigeis.”

Togo Yeisuw ikin taw towen, ikalin nuwan waseg, idibek, ilana, “Katanoka sinap ika̱bwag waseg yak, kadiloka kuymayis muvavag babaw, maysan kukow, kuvgen, kusekes tasiyas tasimavs, mo kum kubkunig; tage maysan bwein igaw mo bukuban walba̱lab.”
Mto taw bo isisiyuw nanon, mo itamanaw, inoun, singay igeg nanon, peinan nawliyoug babaw, ikayus.
Yeisuw gog itouvin, idibakes navamul, ilana, “Singay keikay tasiyas guyawaw beisiws wanuwan Yowbad nakabkaleiwag waseg.”

Navamul gog iliganes anilivan sitovek, bo isunasun ninous. Vayuwein Yeisuw mo idibakes, ilana, “Sigwey, singay keikay tasiyas guyawaw beisiws wanuwan Yowbad nakabkaleiwag waseg. Mansiyas kamel beisiws vas analeg kalimwey-nen keikay, tage guyawaw beisiws Yowbad nakabkaleiwag waseg, singaya keikay.”
Tasiyas gog singay isunasun ninous, illivans sisiyas, ilansa, “Kalisiy kid beisiws Yowbad nakabkaleiwag waseg?”
Yeisuw bo ikinbunikes tasiyas, ilana, “Gamag wasigeis na-ikadilok, tage Yowbad bwein kadilok, peinan Yowbad kadilok youd babaw.”
Iw to Pita, ilana, “Yakamey gog nakapiyev mavavag babaw mo kabkunim.”

Yeisuw ilana, “Mounid adibakeimiy, kal yakamiy bilisow naven, budan, nunet, inan, taman, nitun, o napwepway, va̱gan bikanow agulivan bwanabwein, nagein tut towen mo biban lakatutan nabunatum, budan, nunet, inan, nitun, napwepway; tage gamag mwasanin biyagages; igaw gog tut wanakougwaw mwamovan bises bisigeg.
“Tage babaw tasiyas tumumug bikuyeims, o tasiyas takukuyeims mo bimugwas.”
Sivtounun Yeisuw ilivnek bikanig mo beikit vayuwein

Inounas wa̱ked bineis kid Yelusalem, Yeisuw imug, navamuls wankuyeim bo ikubukub nuwes, sisiyas bod mwasanin wankuyeim aspwa̱yat. Inounas ee... mo idawes navamul sinawatan teiy, vayuwein inekes, ikamteles aveiyag igaw mo bilivet, ilana, “Bitaneis Yelusalem, teitan gamag mo bisilkodeig Gimgilitoun yey, mo biyousigs tasiyas tanuwgwes lun situwa̱vek sisiyas takatimlakeins kaleiwag, biyateleigs bisekeigs wasigeis tobwag ven gimgilis va̱gan beiweigs, bikatimateigs; tasiyas gog bisiba̱weigs, bigusugs, biwaweigs vatul waseg, ikous mo bikatimateigs; yam kweitoun mo ba̱kit vayuwein.”
Yemes son Yon initougs waseg Yeisuw
Sebidiy nitun tasiyas Yemes son Yon mo inekes Yeisuw, ilansa, “Tamwey, sivinem bukutam aveiyag bakalivan.”
Ilana, “Aveiyag sivinamiy?”
Iweis tasiyas, ilansa, “Igaw muguyaw waseg, kutam va̱gan bakasin teitan wamkwa̱tay, teitan wamkimaw.”
Yeisuw idibakes, ilana, “Nag kukwakins silawun mikanitoug towen. Tab kadilok bukumwamwes kwa̱vig towen ba̱moum, o tab kadilok bibapta̱yseimiy ma̱wana bibapta̱yseigs yey?”

Ilansa, “Ikadilokem-wan.” Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Mounid bukumwamwes kwa̱vig towen yey ba̱moum o bibapta̱yseimiy ma̱wana bibapta̱yseigs yey; tage nag kadilok bakaliwageimiy va̱gan bukusinis wagunka̱tay o wagunkimaw, nag. Tamag nakaleiwag towen, bikaleiwag kalisiy bisinis wadadag.”
Navamul gog tasiyas sinawatan iliganes, mo ikawkunes Yemes son Yon.
Mapuna Yeisuw idawes bimeis, binekes; imeis mo idibakes, ilana, “Kukwakinsa tasiyas idokes guyawaw tobwag ven wasigeis, ikaliwages sigamag, siwotet kweitan kweitan isekes biwteles.
“Tage yakamiy nag ma̱wan. Kal yakamiy sivinan biguyaw bweina bimlavag mitouwat.
“Kal yakamiy sivinan bimlavag mitamumug, kadiloka biwotet silma̱nin miwotet.
“Gimgilitoun yey bo ma̱wan, nag am va̱gan bukulabeigs, tage balabeimiy yakamiy, o mwamovag batam mamagina baymiyiseimiy tababaw yakamiy.”
Toukwaw towen Batamiyas ikiplal matan

Ikous anilivan towen, inounas oko ineis Yelikow, ikanapels Yelikow binounas siney navamul sisiyas gamag babaw. Toukwaw teitan nissin wadadan ked ininitoug money wasigeis gamag babaw; yagan Batamiyas, peinan taman yagan Tamiyas.
Toukwaw towen iligen butun gum-Nasalet yagan Yeisuw, peinan bo neim, mo iwak, ilana, “Yeisuw, ya̱koum Deibid tabun ya̱koum, binok nuwam yey.”
Babaw gamag bo ika̱nes, ilansa, “Kukwa̱pay.” Togo singaya iwkuwak, ilana, “Ya̱koum Deibid tabun ya̱koum, binok nuwam yey.”
Yeisuw gog im itom, ilana, “Kudibakes beim.” Mapuna idibakes toukwaw towen, ilansa, “Bweina kutamanaw kum. Bo idaweim.”
Togo ilavew anpwa̱lum, nuwanaw mo itamanaw, inoun inek Yeisuw.
Inek Yeisuw, Yeisuw ikatigan, ilana, “Aveiyag sivinam bavag peinam yak?” Iw toukwaw towen, ilana, “Tamwey, sivinag beilal matag.”
Yeisuw gog idibek, ilana, “Nukusimounid waseg yey, mapuna bo kubwein; bweina kunoun.” Nuwanaw ilal matan, mo ibwa̱kun Yeisuw waseg.
